purpose: Complete the pending native Administrator and delegation checks in an ordinary Windows desktop session.
storagePolicy: Use a separate short release folder under D:/Codex; preserve the previous package/workspace and any exported backups. These checks do not apply XPU drafts, restore, reset or replace a volume.

steps.action: Check the release ZIP hash against its supplied sidecar and extract to a separate short folder such as D:/Codex/JA21-1.4. Launch Start Console.cmd from File Explorer outside Codex.
Wait for XPU 1 and XPU 2 prompts. If startup fails, save the displayed error and workspace/logs/boot-latest.log; report the startup gate as failed.
Open Administrator PowerShell using the console button. Confirm the Windows request for the packaged JA21-Admin-Terminal.exe. Record whether startup completes or the request was cancelled.

Run the proof command below in Administrator PowerShell and copy its resulting JSON. Actual administrator must be true; each terminal result must have code 0, completion COMPLETED and truncated false. Check each unique marker appears in its corresponding XPU tab. The GPU preview result must explicitly report a successful actual GPU check. Leave its preview unsaved.

Record powerShellPid from the proof, then close the Administrator tab with its close button. From a regular Windows PowerShell window, run Get-Process -Id <recorded PID> -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue. No returned process confirms the owned PowerShell exited.

Reopen Administrator PowerShell and run the two xpu info delegation checks again; record the new PID. Close it, reopen once more and cancel the Windows elevation request. Verify no connected Administrator terminal remains and XPU 1 and XPU 2 still respond.
Share the proof JSON, the owned-process closure result, a screenshot of the three terminal tabs when connected, and any exact startup/delegation error text. Mark any unperformed step NOT_RUN.

proofCommand: $ja21Proof=[ordered]@{utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');powerShellPid=$PID;administrator=([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator);terminal1=(Invoke-JA21Terminal -Terminal 1 -Command 'xpu info');terminal2=(Invoke-JA21Terminal -Terminal 2 -Command 'xpu info');marker1=(Invoke-JA21Terminal -Terminal 1 -Command 'echo JA21-ACCEPTANCE-T1');marker2=(Invoke-JA21Terminal -Terminal 2 -Command 'echo JA21-ACCEPTANCE-T2');gpuPreview=(Invoke-JA21Terminal -Terminal 2 -Command 'xpu run add 1 2 8 4 gpu field')};$ja21Proof|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
claimsAfterSuccess: Actual Windows Administrator PowerShell startup after operator consent
Native named-pipe delegation to the two existing XPU terminal sessions
Real browser GPU confirmation requested through native delegation
Owned administrator process closes with its tab
Cancellation and reopening retain the existing XPU sessions
